blindSummary:
A 2025 anti-discrimination amendment statute (assented October 2025; the relevant part in force from July 2026) removed the civil provision making it unlawful to "offend, insult, humiliate or intimidate" a person in public on the basis of a protected attribute, including gender identity. This state/province is the only one in the country that has actively reversed anti-discrimination protection rather than extended it; the government framed the rollback as "restoring freedom of speech and religion." For a visitor, public verbal abuse or humiliation directed at gender expression is now deliberately outside this state/province's law while other states/provinces have brought it inside.

Federal protections continue to apply uniformly: the national sex-discrimination statute (1984) covers gender identity in every state/province, and this state/province's hate-crime penalty enhancements for SOGI-motivated offences (a 2022 amendment, effective 2023) remain in force. No criminal expression ban, no facility-access ban, and no conversion-practice-specific enforcement issue arises for a short-term visitor beyond the general federal framework.

Remote-area context amplifies practical risk: a large remote town here records approximately 2,600+ assaults per year against a population of ~25,000, and trans community infrastructure in this state/province is thin. A single domestic killing of a trans woman from an island community (in the capital, October 2024) is recorded for completeness but is one non-patterned incident and does not support a regional violence finding on its own.

Local risk sits a clear margin below the country-wide average: the deliberate legislative removal of the "offend, insult, humiliate" protection is the strongest negative sub-national signal in the country, even though it is a civil-law rollback rather than a criminal prohibition. In the same year, another state/province created the country's first criminal offence for public incitement against a trans person; this state/province moved in the opposite direction.
